title: Deliver the live Bees TUI
description: Live terminal issue workbench, safe concurrent editing, read-only browsing, Git indicators, standalone distribution and maintenance. Bulk snapshot refresh remains open.

title: Build and validate a standalone Bun TUI executable
description: Add a repeatable single-file executable build and real terminal smoke coverage. Verify packaged React Ink/Yoga compatibility and detached execution without node_modules. Document separate Bees and optional Git dependencies and platform validation limits.
close_reason: Added scripts/build-binary.mjs, build:binary npm/mise tasks and test:binary mise task. Bun 1.3.6 compiles host executable; build plugin removes optional Ink debugger import without externalizing runtime dependencies. Windows x64 release/bees-tui.exe is 113753600 bytes. Detached-copy smoke verifies help, Yoga preview, real ConPTY live updates, navigation, resize, JSONL preservation and clean exit. mise run test:binary passes; mise run test passes typecheck/build and 93 tests. README and docs/DESIGN.md explain runtime bundling, external Bees/optional Git and platform limits. Logs validation-binary-build.log, validation-binary-test.log, validation-binary-suite.log. No commit made. Other OS execution remains unverified.

title: Preserve JSONL during browsing and show Git changes and live activity
description: Verify read-only TUI navigation preserves exact JSONL bytes, including noncanonical formatting and ordering. Show per-issue staged or unstaged JSONL change markers without writing or staging files. Replace flashing Refreshing header with fixed live label and a restrained receive pulse, respecting no-motion and screen readers.
close_reason: Implemented per-record Git HEAD/index/working JSONL markers in Queue, Board, Graph and Inspector; legend moved to ? help per user preference. Fixed-width Live light pulses only after successful reads and respects no-motion/screen reader. Browsing issues.jsonl byte preservation verified with noncanonical JSONL, fresh-clone hydration, and direct/mise real PTY navigation. Git index also remains byte-identical during reads. Updated README. Changed src/git-changes.ts, live-status.tsx, client.ts, session.ts, model.ts, live.tsx, views.tsx, graph.tsx plus focused tests. mise run test passed typecheck/build and all 93 tests; retained log validation-live-indicators.log. No commit made. No backend changes required.

title: Keep graph tracks stable during keyboard navigation
description: Selection changes interrupt dependency hydration and publish a partially loaded graph, collapsing and rebuilding tracks. Finish graph hydration independently of selection; retain the last complete graph during reads or failures. Add regression coverage for rapid navigation and external relationship changes.
close_reason: Fixed graph hydration cancellation on cursor/tab changes: finish all relationship reads before publishing, preserving existing tracks during refresh and on failure. Regression reproduced before the fix. Added session topology assertions and real Bees CLI branching/merge navigation coverage. mise run test passes typecheck, build and all 85 tests including both terminal launch paths.

title: Preserve interactive terminal when launching with mise
description: mise run start captures standard streams so the CLI falls back to a static issue list. Configure start/demo for raw terminal I/O and cover the actual mise launch path with a real PTY test.
close_reason: Set raw=true on mise start/demo tasks. Added a regression test that launches via mise run start in Windows ConPTY and verifies interactive rendering, external CLI updates, keyboard navigation, resize, and clean exit. Both direct and mise PTY tests pass; typecheck passes.

title: Use Bees bulk snapshots for TUI refresh
description: Bees bees-23 is complete: snapshot --json [--since revision] returns consistent issues, labels, typed dependencies, comments and ready IDs. Replace TUI list/ready/show/per-issue dependency refresh fan-out with this endpoint. Preserve drafts and selection, retain last-good state on failures, handle unchanged responses and project switches, and test independent CLI updates. This is the TUI-side follow-up; the requested Bees-repository work is complete.

title: Use atomic conditional writes for TUI mutations
description: Integrate the atomic mutation contract from Bees bees-21. Prevent stale TUI drafts and undo operations from overwriting concurrent CLI edits. Validate conflicts using independent real CLI processes. New work and findings belong in this TUI tracker.
close_reason: Integrated Bees --if-revision conditional writes into TUI save and undo preflight. Conflicts retain drafts, old CLI builds cannot silently perform unguarded edits. All 82 TUI tests pass, including simultaneous CLI writers, every guarded mutation kind, and an injected preflight/save race.

title: Remove retired demo and browser preview
description: Remove prototype UI, browser assets, CLI flags, npm/mise tasks and unused dependencies. Keep fixture data under test only and preserve useful live keyboard/layout and standalone coverage. Update README, design and local instructions; rebuild distributable artifacts.
close_reason: Removed src/app.tsx, demo-only tests, browser scripts/assets and screenshot, CLI demo/preview flags, npm/mise tasks and ink-text-input/ansi-to-html dependencies. Moved sample data to test/fixtures.ts; removed unused demo panes and stale dist files. Added live keyboard/draft/layout coverage; binary smoke now tests live listing and rejects retired flags. Updated README, design and AGENTS. mise run test passes typecheck/build and 76 tests (23 obsolete demo tests removed, 6 live tests added); mise run test:binary passes with rebuilt executable. npm pack dry run confirms no obsolete artifacts. Logs validation-remove-prototypes-*.log retained. No commit made.

title: Configure mise tasks and local Bees executable for TUI development
description: Pin the validated Node runtime, expose setup/build/start/demo/test/preview/tracker tasks, and resolve the sibling Bees executable. Persist project-specific issue tracker guidance.
close_reason: Added and trusted mise.toml; pinned Node 25.6.1; verified mise exec node, bees version, tracker task, and mise run test. Added AGENTS.md tracker routing.
